dict.string: NutirLift reads steps, active energy, workouts, and body mass from Apple Health to show daily activity and optional weight trends. All data stays on your device.
NutirLift may write body mass you log in the app to Apple Health if you choose. Nothing is uploaded to NutirLift servers.
Scan packaged-food barcodes and take meal photos for nutrition logging. Photos and scans stay on your device. Optional online barcode lookup uses Open Food Facts only when you choose it.
Choose a meal photo for on-device nutrition estimates. Photos stay on your device and are not uploaded.
